meta.title: Ballmania — marble shooting reinvented
meta.description: Chain marble shooting reinvented: a six-world campaign, new modes, spectacular explosions. Free, no sign-up, on mobile and desktop.

hints.aim: Aim at the chain and shoot: three balls of the same colour explode.
hints.swap: Swap the loaded ball with the next one: tap the shooter or press X.
hints.reaction: When two pieces of the same colour meet, they explode in turn: that's a chain reaction.
hints.colours: A fourth colour joins the game.
hints.twin: Two chains at once: watch both holes.
hints.colossus: The Colossus pushes the chain: blow up balls right next to it to hurt it.
hints.ricochet: Walls bounce your shots back. A ball hit after one rebound is worth ×2, after two ×3.
hints.prism: Prisms bounce shots too: follow the aim line, it shows every rebound.
hints.spin: These prisms turn: wait for the right angle before you shoot.
hints.magnet: Tap “Magnet” (or M), then aim at a ball: it leaves the chain and joins your shooter.
hints.magnetCombo: Pull out the ball that separates two equal colours: they join and explode.
hints.alchemy: Light mixes: ruby + lime = amber, lime + violet = cyan, ruby + violet = rose. Shoot one colour onto another to fuse them.
hints.alchemySecondary: Mixed colours cannot be shot: fuse three of them side by side to blow them up.
hints.switch: Tap a switch (or press S) to send the lava into the detour: longer, it buys you time. It can no longer change once the chain gets there.
hints.hot: On the shortcut the lava is molten: balls blown up there are worth double. Points or time: your call.
hints.gravity: The black hole pulls your shots: the aim line shows the curve they will follow. A shot passing too close is swallowed.
hints.orbit: Your shooter glides around the black hole: wait until you are well placed before you fire.
hints.endless: The chain never stops: each stage speeds it up and may add a colour. Hold on as long as you can.
hints.puzzle: The chain stands still and your shots are counted. "Next colour" (or X) picks the colour: think chain reactions.
hints.rhythm: The chain moves to the music. Fire as the ring closes on the shooter: the groove multiplies your points up to ×4.
hints.duel: Every explosion pushes the chain towards the other hole. Make it fall into your rival's before it reaches yours.
hints.arrhythmia: Arrhythmia: the chain speeds up and slows down without warning. The track turns red when it races.
hints.meteors: Balls fall from the sky: a shadow shows where they will land.
hints.wind: Headwinds: during a gust, the aim line shows how your shots drift. A charged shot (hold) flies straight.
hints.cold: Biting cold: shots slow down and balls freeze. Set off a chain reaction to shatter every frozen ball.
hints.solar: Solar storm: the balls cannot be destroyed. Build groups: they will all explode when it ends.
